description: This file defines the SugarWidgetFieldFloat class, a subclass of SugarWidgetFieldInt, providing methods for displaying and filtering float number fields in the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM framework.

classes.name: SugarWidgetFieldFloat
classes.description: A widget class for rendering float fields in list views and supporting filter operations.

methods.name: displayList
methods.description: Formats and returns the float value for display in list views, considering the specified precision.

methods.name: displayListPlain
methods.description: Returns the unformatted float value for display; calls displayList.

methods.name: queryFilterEquals
methods.description: Generates SQL filter for equality comparison of float fields.

methods.name: queryFilterNot_Equals
methods.description: Generates SQL filter for inequality comparison of float fields.

methods.name: queryFilterGreater
methods.description: Generates SQL filter for greater-than comparison.

methods.name: queryFilterLess
methods.description: Generates SQL filter for less-than comparison.

methods.name: queryFilterBetween
methods.description: Generates SQL filter for between comparison.
